purpose: Teach: 下巻/ストローク/ガイダンス/仕手/各論/持ち味/後発/自助

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社史の下巻の編集を急げ
lines.en: Let's accelerate the second volume of our company history.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. Slight pause after the opening thought, as if weighing the urgency. Direct eye contact. No room for questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業のストロークを増やします
lines.en: Yes. We'll increase our sales outreach.
lines.style: Businesslike affirmation. Immediate, no hesitation. Writing it down mentally as he speaks. Efficient, factual — not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人ガイダンスを準備しろ
lines.en: And prepare the new employee orientation materials.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact instruction, stacked on the previous order. Slight acceleration — moving through the list. The tone of someone orchestrating multiple tasks at once.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の仕手筋に注意してます
lines.en: Understood. We're monitoring market movements closely.
lines.style: Steady assurance. Lean into 'monitoring' slightly — shows he's already on it. Even cadence, competent but not overeager.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 総論よりも各論で議論しろ
lines.en: Then focus the discussion on specifics, not generalities.
lines.style: Firm correction, lightly pedagogical. Emphasize the distinction — the difference matters. Cool, expecting it to land. No repetition needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の持ち味を打ち出した広告を作ります
lines.en: Right. I'll create advertising that showcases our unique strengths.
lines.style: Committed acknowledgement. Slight lift on 'showcase' — he's already visualizing the work. Grounded, purposeful — not promising, just stating.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、後発でも一気に追い抜け
lines.en: Even as a latecomer, we'll pull ahead decisively.
lines.style: Charged with quiet conviction. Lean on 'decisively' — this is not a suggestion, it's a vision. Composed authority, but with an edge of ambition underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の自助努力を支援します
lines.en: Yes. I'll support our team's individual initiative and effort.
lines.style: Final affirmation, carrying weight. Slightly slower than before — the closing note. Respectful toward what the team will do, not condescending.
